mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(o.gmv,0) gmv, IFNULL(o.payOrderCount,0) payOrderCount, IFNULL(o.payBuyerCount,0) payBuyerCount, IFNULL(r.afterSalesOrderCount,0) afterSalesOrderCount, IFNULL(r.refundAmount,0) refundAmount, CASE WHEN o.payOrderCount > 0 THEN o.gmv / o.payOrderCount ELSE 0 END AS averageTicketSize FROM ( SELECT SUM(payment_price) AS gmv, COUNT(id) AS payOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS payBuyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) o LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS afterSalesOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN arrival_status = '2' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END) AS refundAmount FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) r ON 1=1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(payment_time, #{format}) AS timePoint, IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS gmv, COUNT(id) AS payOrderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS payBuyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY timePoint ORDER BY timePoint

SELECT oi.spu_name AS spuName, oi.pic_url AS picUrl, IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) AS salesAmount, IFNULL(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS refundAmount, CASE WHEN IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) > 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) / SUM(oi.payment_price) ELSE 0 END AS refundRate FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN order_refund r ON oi.id = r.order_item_id AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.arrival_status = '2' WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY oi.spu_id, oi.spu_name, oi.pic_url ORDER BY refundRate DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT user_id FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(id) >= 2 ) t

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) FROM order_info t1 WHERE t1.del_flag = '0' AND t1.pay_status = '1' AND t1.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_info t2 WHERE t2.user_id = t1.user_id AND t2.pay_status = '1' AND t2.del_flag = '0' AND t2.payment_time < #{dto.startTime} )

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}) AS afterSalesCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND arrival_status = '2' AND update_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS refundCompletedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '2' AND payment_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS unshippedTimeoutCount

SELECT oi.spu_name AS spuName, oi.pic_url AS picUrl, IFNULL(SUM(oi.buy_quantity), 0) AS salesCount, IFNULL(SUM(oi.payment_price), 0) AS salesAmount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN order_info o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY oi.spu_id, oi.spu_name, oi.pic_url ORDER BY salesCount DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS waitingForPaymentCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '2' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS waitingForDeliveryCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '3' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS shippedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '4' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS completedCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status = '1' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS afterSalesCount, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND arrival_status = '2' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}) AS refundedCount

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS oneTimeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS twoToThreeTimesCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount BETWEEN 4 AND 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fourToFiveTimesCount, SUM(CASE WHEN orderCount >= 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sixPlusTimesCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(id) AS orderCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) t

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount0To100Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 100 AND totalAmount <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount100To500Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 500 AND totalAmount <= 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount500To2000Count, SUM(CASE WHEN totalAmount > 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount2000PlusCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(payment_price) AS totalAmount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) t

SELECT COUNT(1) AS createdCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' AND deliver_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deliveredCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' AND receiver_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completedCount, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) FROM order_refund r INNER JOIN order_info o2 ON r.order_id = o2.id WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.arrival_status = '2' AND o2.del_flag = '0' AND o2.create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} ) AS refundedCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}

SELECT segment, COUNT(1) AS userCount, IFNULL(SUM(monetary), 0) AS gmv FROM ( SELECT user_id, monetary, CASE WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN '重要价值客户' WHEN r_score >= 4 AND f_score >= 4 THEN '重要发展客户' WHEN r_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN '重要保持客户' WHEN f_score >= 4 AND m_score >= 4 THEN '重要挽留客户' WHEN r_score >= 4 THEN '新客/潜力客户' WHEN f_score >= 4 THEN '高频低额客户' WHEN m_score >= 4 THEN '高额低频客户' ELSE '一般客户' END AS segment FROM ( SELECT user_id, monetary, CASE WHEN recency_days <= 7 THEN 5 WHEN recency_days <= 30 THEN 4 WHEN recency_days <= 90 THEN 3 WHEN recency_days <= 180 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS r_score, CASE WHEN frequency >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN frequency >= 6 THEN 4 WHEN frequency >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN frequency >= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS f_score, CASE WHEN monetary >= 5000 THEN 5 WHEN monetary >= 2000 THEN 4 WHEN monetary >= 1000 THEN 3 WHEN monetary >= 500 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS m_score FROM ( SELECT user_id, DATEDIFF(#{dto.endTime}, MAX(payment_time)) AS recency_days, COUNT(1) AS frequency, SUM(payment_price) AS monetary FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time IS NOT NULL AND payment_time <= #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) stats ) scored ) segmented GROUP BY segment ORDER BY FIELD(segment, '重要价值客户', '重要发展客户', '重要保持客户', '重要挽留客户', '新客/潜力客户', '高频低额客户', '高额低频客户', '一般客户')

SELECT cohort_month AS cohortMonth, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS cohortSize, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 0 THEN user_id END) AS month0, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 1 THEN user_id END) AS month1, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 2 THEN user_id END) AS month2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 3 THEN user_id END) AS month3, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 4 THEN user_id END) AS month4, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period_diff = 5 THEN user_id END) AS month5 FROM ( SELECT o.user_id, DATE_FORMAT(first_order.first_paid_month, '%Y-%m') AS cohort_month, PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(o.payment_time, '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(first_order.first_paid_month, '%Y%m')) AS period_diff FROM order_info o INNER JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MIN(payment_time) AS first_paid_month FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time IS NOT NULL AND payment_time <= #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id ) first_order ON o.user_id = first_order.user_id WHERE o.del_flag = '0' AND o.pay_status = '1' AND o.payment_time IS NOT NULL AND o.payment_time <= #{dto.endTime} ) t WHERE cohort_month >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(#{dto.endTime}, INTERVAL 5 MONTH), '%Y-%m') GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS gmv, COUNT(1) AS orderCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS gmv, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS createdBuyerCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pay_status = '1' THEN user_id END) AS paidBuyerCount FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}

SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(1) AS orderCount, IFNULL(SUM(payment_price), 0) AS gmv FROM order_info WHERE del_flag = '0' AND pay_status = '1' AND payment_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY user_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS afterSalesOrderCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN arrival_status = '2' THEN refund_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS refundAmount FROM order_refund WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime}
